result.stdout:
Description:
  Reads and checks version information from .csproj, .sln and .slnx files.

Usage:
  dotnet-version [command] [options]

Options:
  -i, --input <input>                     Path to a .csproj, .sln, .slnx file or a folder. Defaults to the current directory.
  -o, --output <Json|List|Table|Version>  Output format: json (default), table, or version (single project only). [default: Json]
  -f, --filter <filter>                   Filter in the form 'XmlNode=Value' (value may be a regex). Can be specified multiple times.
  -?, -h, --help                          Show help and usage information
  --version                               Show version information

Commands:
  read   Reads and displays version information from .csproj files. This is the default command.
  check  Checks that every project whose source files have changed (relative to --base) has had its version bumped. Exits with code 1 if any project requires a bump, code 2 on usage errors.
  diff   Shows projects whose version has changed (or that are new) relative to --base. Does not exit with a non-zero code based on results.

Description:
  Checks that every project whose source files have changed (relative to --base) has had its version bumped. Exits with code 1 if any project requires a bump, code 2 on usage errors.

Usage:
  dotnet-version check [options]

Options:
  -i, --input <input>                     Path to a .csproj, .sln, .slnx file or a folder. Defaults to the current directory.
  -b, --base <base>                       The git ref to compare against. All projects whose files differ between this ref and --head will be checked. [default: origin/main]
  --head <head>                           The git ref representing the current (PR) state. Defaults to HEAD. [default: HEAD]
  -o, --output <Json|List|Table|Version>  Output format: json (default), table, or version (single project only). [default: Json]
  -f, --filter <filter>                   Filter in the form 'XmlNode=Value' (value may be a regex). Can be specified multiple times.
  -?, -h, --help                          Show help and usage information

Description:
  Shows projects whose version has changed (or that are new) relative to --base. Does not exit with a non-zero code based on results.

Usage:
  dotnet-version diff [options]

Options:
  -i, --input <input>                     Path to a .csproj, .sln, .slnx file or a folder. Defaults to the current directory.
  -b, --base <base>                       The git ref to compare against. Defaults to origin/main. [default: origin/main]
  --head <head>                           The git ref representing the current state. Defaults to HEAD. [default: HEAD]
  -o, --output <Json|List|Table|Version>  Output format: json (default), table, or version (single project only). [default: Json]
  -f, --filter <filter>                   Filter in the form 'XmlNode=Value' (value may be a regex). Can be specified multiple times.
  --bump, --fix                           Automatically write the suggested version into each affected .csproj file (only for projects with status DependenciesChanged). Defaults to false.
  -?, -h, --help                          Show help and usage information
